review_text_raw: This is gonna contain spoilers but this game makes me so angry. Why did we kill off Jabbr and pretty much any of the other apps in the first two games?? It was so fun like hello you can't remove the apps that made the game feel like you were on an actual phone, and not to mention the dialogue is crap none of the characters even sound like real people and to add onto that THERE IS NO CHARACTERS, why are we stuck with Ruby for the entire shitshow? She isn't funny and honestly comes off as an asshole during most of it. She's like a tutorial character that never shuts up. AND THE PUZZLES SUCK they are complicated to the extent where it's not enjoyable and there isn't even that many so how they managed to make the three puzzles you do feel complicated or straight up not challenging is BEYOND me. And honestly the game is such a downgrade from the first two you'd think this came before them both. Did we kill off the entire development studio from the first two games?? I'd call this a cash grab but it doesn't even feel like it wants money, just my hopes and dreams for the third game down the shitter. Haven't finished it yet but it feels so dead and boring. Also the "monster" being 3d is genuinely the worst choice the game has made, the first jumpscare wasn't even scary because of how ugly the thing was and also WHERE DID THE JUMPSCARES GO AT ALL?? There is a maximum of like two and neither of them are good. I say all this with genuine love from the first two games because I really really did enjoy them but this is just terrible. Don't buy this during a sale, don't even get it if it's free. Get the first two and don't look beyond that. I'd refund this crap if I could. TLDR The game is shit don't waste your money on this ever.
